div.div: FP<IntT, OneV>: IntT storage; OneV encodes 1.0 and need not be an integer.
QAT: FT OneV 256 (max 255); hidden OneV 128 (max 127); affine scales 128/64/128.
Router selects one of 32 subnets by piece count and queen presence. Formulas omit quantization and integer rounding.

pc = (pieces - 1) / 4
q = 2*stmQ + oppQ (Q: queen)
stack = 4*pc + q
32 stacks
